name: Fujimiya Nozomi
source:
Fujimiya Nozomi serves tables with her sister [url=/c13712]Wakaba[/url]. She is skilled at Kendo, although she has a weak heart and often needs [url=/c13712]Wakaba[/url] to heal her when she collapses. She loves her sister, but feels guilty that her poor health is a burden. [spoiler]She and [url=/c13712]Wakaba[/url] are adopted siblings.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wind:_A_Breath_of_Heart]Wikipedia[/url]]
